hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); DEF=$(git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^origin/||'); DEF=${DEF:-main}; if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && [ "$BRANCH" = "$DEF" ]; then echo "⚠️ On $DEF — create a feature branch before changes (git checkout -b feat/<desc>)."; fi
hooks.description: Remind to use a feature branch when on the default branch

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); PROMPT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.prompt // ""' 2>/dev/null); case "$PROMPT" in /*) exit 0;; esac; if [ ! -f docs/WORKFLOW.md ] && [ ! -d .plans ]; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$PROMPT" | grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*(what|how|why|who|whom|whose|when|where|which|is|are|am|do|does|did|can|could|should|would|will|explain|tell me|show me|thanks|thank you)([^a-z]|$)'; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(^|[^a-z])(add|build|implement|create|ship|fix|refactor|feature|make|write|scaffold|integrate|set up|rework|redesign|rename|migrate)([^a-z]|$)'; then echo "↪ This looks like a work request with no command — route it through the workflow (classify altitude → the matching /agentic-workflow: command, or /agentic-workflow:next if unsure; hand a feature request to the intake agent). Don't answer off-protocol."; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Router (D2): soft-nudge an un-prefixed work request to route through the workflow; silent on slash-commands, plain questions/chat, and non-workflow cwd (no docs/WORKFLOW.md and no .plans/); stdout-inject only, never exit 2

mission-budget (D3, UserPromptSubmit) — supersedes the thread-keeper: injects the active ledger's status line (`Mission <name> — session k/N (est.)`) + its FIRST `Next up:` line every turn; active = newest-mtime non-complete .plans/*.state.md (the shared predicate). Two mechanisms from orderly's §12 retro: LA-7 — reads `Next up:` with head -1 and warns loudly when more than one line matches (the old tail -1 fed the owner the stalest state for a day); LA-1 — reads `Estimate: N sessions` and `Sessions used: k` from the ledger and, when 2k ≥ 3N (≥1.5× the planner's estimate), emits the OVERRUN scope-decision text on every prompt until the estimate is revised — a protocol STOP for the orchestrator (no further brief until the owner chooses subset / revised estimate / abort), never a hook block; missing Estimate → one-line reminder. Silent when no .plans/ or no active ledger; ledger text grepped/echoed only, never executed; always exit 0. Body: hooks/lib/mission-budget.sh

handoff-budget nudge (UserPromptSubmit): when the transcript_path byte count (wc -c — the only signal; a loose cumulative proxy, NOT tokens; bands derived from n=1 in S2) crosses ADVISORY_BYTES=3700000 or URGENT_BYTES=5380000, echo a ≤3-line nudge to write/refresh docs/product/session-handoff.md before compaction takes the window. Exactly four silencers (OQ4, human-locked): (1) at most two bands — below advisory, silence; (2) once per band per session ($TMPDIR marker keyed by session_id); (3) silent when session-handoff.md is newer than the transcript (the handoff already postdates the crossing); (4) silent when an active .plans/*.state.md ledger exists (OQ7; thread-keeper predicate verbatim). Advisory only — always exit 0, incl. missing transcript_path/session_id/jq. Body: hooks/lib/handoff-budget.sh

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT"); D=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed -n 's/^ *cd  *\([^;&|]*\).*/\1/p' | sed 's/"//g; s/ *$//'); if [ -z "$D" ]; then D=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed -n 's/.*git -C  *\([^ ;&|]*\).*/\1/p' | sed 's/"//g'); fi; D=${D:-.}; DEF=$(git -C "$D" symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^origin/||'); DEF=${DEF:-main}; case "$CMD" in *'git commit'*) echo '📝 Commit format: type(scope): description — end with a Co-Authored-By trailer.';; esac; ISPUSH=0; case "$CMD" in *'git push'*|*'git -C '*' push'*) ISPUSH=1;; esac; if [ "$ISPUSH" = 1 ]; then BRANCH=$(git -C "$D" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "$DEF" ]; then echo "❌ BLOCKED: never push while checked out on $DEF (target repo: $D) — work on a feature branch; branch-switch and push in SEPARATE commands (checks read pre-execution state)." >&2; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE ":(refs/heads/)?$DEF([^A-Za-z0-9_/-]|$)"; then echo "❌ BLOCKED: push refspec targets $DEF — direct pushes to the default branch are never allowed (even with delegated merge authority); open a PR." >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$CMD" in *'--tags'*|*'--follow-tags'*) echo '⚠️ Tag push may trigger a release/deploy pipeline — per /release, the human runs it.';; esac; if git -C "$D" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo '⚠️ Tracked files have uncommitted modifications — confirm they belong to a later commit before pushing.'; fi; fi; case "$CMD" in *'gh pr merge'*) TOP=$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$TOP" ] && grep -qE '\| *\*\*Merge policy\*\* *\| *agent-may-merge' "$TOP/docs/WORKFLOW.md" 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚠️ Delegated merge authority (§10 Merge policy) — merge only on a reviewer APPROVE (or §13 bookkeeping scope) and log it in the ledger.'; else echo '❌ BLOCKED: the human (HITL) merges PRs. Delegating needs Merge policy = agent-may-merge in the TARGET repo docs/WORKFLOW.md §10 — run as cd <repo> && gh pr merge … (fail closed).' >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; case "$CMD" in *'gh pr create'*) echo '📋 Run the project gates before the PR (test + typecheck/lint; build if release-bound).';; esac; exit 0
hooks.description: git/gh guardrails, evaluated in the command's TARGET repo (leading `cd <dir>` or `git -C <dir>`, else session cwd): block push on/into the default branch (incl. refspecs); policy-aware gh pr merge block; tag-push, commit-format, pre-PR reminders; dirty-tracked-tree warning

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT"); case "$CMD" in *'git commit'*) if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -iqE '(close|closes|closed|fix|fixes|fixed|resolve|resolves|resolved)[[:space:]:]+([a-z0-9_.-]+/[a-z0-9_.-]+)?#[0-9]+'; then echo "❌ BLOCKED: a closing keyword (Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N) in a COMMIT MESSAGE fires GitHub auto-close whenever the commit reaches the default branch — it rides the staging→main promote and closes the issue at the wrong time, done or not (orderly #605, 2026-08-19). Closing an issue is a decision made in the PR-to-default-branch BODY, reviewed at that moment. Move the keyword there; a commit may reference an issue as \"(#N)\" or \"refs #N\" but must never carry a close directive." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
hooks.description: close-keyword guard (PreToolUse/Bash): BLOCK a `git commit` whose message carries a GitHub closing keyword + issue ref (Closes/Fixes/Resolves #N, incl. owner/repo#N). Such a keyword in a durable commit message fires auto-close whenever the commit lands on the default branch — including via the staging→main promote — closing the issue done-or-not (orderly #605). A bare `(#N)` PR reference or `refs #N` is allowed; only the close directive is blocked. Closing is a PR-to-default-branch BODY decision, reviewed at the close moment.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT"); D=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed -n 's/^ *cd  *\([^;&|]*\).*/\1/p' | sed 's/"//g; s/ *$//'); D=${D:-.}; TOP=$(git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); WF="$TOP/docs/WORKFLOW.md"; if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'ads-api\.|googleads|adaccounts|/act_[0-9]+/|/ads/'; then if ! printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -q 'PAID_CONFIRMED_BY_HUMAN'; then echo '❌ BLOCKED: paid promotion crosses the money boundary (§11) — never delegable; it must be human-fired within the budget ceiling. No autonomous ad spend.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'api\.(x|twitter|linkedin)\.com|dev\.to/api|buttondown|mailchimp|bsky\.social|hashnode|/api/v1/statuses'; then if grep -qiE '\*\*Publish policy\*\* *\| *_?may-publish' "$WF" 2>/dev/null; then echo '📣 Publishing under a delegated Publish policy (§14) — post only approved, due, organic queue items within scope; append each to publish-log.md.'; else echo '📣 Publishing is §14-gated: Publish policy is not delegated — post only an approved queue item via a human-fired /publish run, and log it. Paid stays human-fired.'; fi; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: publishing guardrail (§14): hard-block paid/ad-spend endpoints unless human-confirmed (never delegable); remind that organic publish-host calls must be policy-authorized, approved queue items logged to publish-log.md

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); F=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null); L=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.limit // ""' 2>/dev/null); READ_ADVISORY_LINES=800; if [ -n "$F" ] && [ -z "$L" ] && [ -f "$F" ]; then N=$(wc -l < "$F" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); if [ -n "$N" ] && [ "$N" -gt "$READ_ADVISORY_LINES" ]; then echo "📖 Large whole-file read ($N lines, over the $READ_ADVISORY_LINES-line advisory threshold) — prefer a ranged read (offset/limit) or delegate to a subagent that returns a bounded distillate (§2 / §6.2 Delegated reads). The main agent ingests conclusions, not corpora."; fi; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: context-discipline backstop (§2/§6.2 Delegated reads): advisory reminder when a whole-file Read (no limit) targets a file over READ_ADVISORY_LINES=800 — the named constant replaces a bare literal (the A3 lesson: unnamed thresholds get pinned by zero cases). Evidence base, same as the handoff-budget bands: transcript growth is dominated by tool output (context-economy-metrics.md — `tool results` was the largest category no prior phase touched), and a whole-file read of a large file is the biggest single tool-output item an orchestrator controls; the 800-line point is a discipline line (~2 briefs' worth of one session's read budget, §5), not a measured optimum — no effect size is claimed. Prefer a ranged read or a subagent that returns a distillate; never blocks (exit 0)

beat-enforcer (D4, PreToolUse/Bash): soft-nudge at the closing action — on git commit / gh pr create|merge, if the active .plans/*.state.md ledger has a NOT-STARTED [ ] Checkpoint or chronicler/reviewer row, echo an advisory to spawn it before close/advance. Keys on the glyph, not prose: [~] (in-flight/deferred/awaiting owner) and [x] (done) rows are silent. Silent when no .plans/ or no such row; ledger text is only grepped/echoed, never executed; always exit 0 (never blocks, per locked D4). Body: hooks/lib/beat-enforcer-pretooluse.sh

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILEPATH=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$INPUT"); case "$FILEPATH" in *CLAUDE.md*|*AGENTS.md*|*docs/WORKFLOW.md*|*docs/architecture*|*docs/data-model*) echo '📚 High-impact file changed — update related docs in the same PR (stale-doc rule).';; esac; case "$FILEPATH" in */server/api/*|*schema.prisma|*/prisma/schema/*|*schema.sql) if [ -f tools/catalog.mjs ]; then echo '📚 Route/schema changed — regenerate the catalog (node tools/catalog.mjs) and rewrite the affected docs/product/catalog/features.md row in this PR (§6.1); the reviewer gates it.'; else echo '📚 High-impact file changed — update related docs in the same PR (stale-doc rule).'; fi;; esac; exit 0
hooks.description: Docs reminder when high-impact files change; on a route file (server/api/**) or the schema, when the project ships tools/catalog.mjs, the reminder names the catalog (§6.1: regenerate derived files + rewrite the feature row in the same PR — the reviewer gates it), else the plain stale-doc reminder

beat-enforcer backstop (D4, Stop): on turn-end, nudge ONCE about a NOT-STARTED [ ] Checkpoint/chronicler/reviewer row then allow the stop. FIRST reads stdin and exits 0 immediately when .stop_hook_active is true (Claude Code's re-fire guard — without it a Stop hook that emits feedback loops on every stop attempt). Keys on the glyph, not prose: [~] (in-flight/deferred/awaiting owner) and [x] (done) rows are silent. Emits via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (jq-built so ledger text is JSON-escaped, never executed); silent when no .plans/ or no such row; always exit 0 — NEVER exit 2. Body: hooks/lib/beat-enforcer-stop.sh

compact-resume directive (D8, SessionStart): after a context compaction ONLY (matcher `compact` — never startup/resume; also silent when stdin's .source is present and not `compact`), inject a ≤6-line re-read directive with THREE branches, never silence (OQ6): (1) active .plans/*.state.md ledger (same newest-mtime rule as the beat-enforcer) → re-read the ledger + handoff VERBATIM, honor ## Standing steers; (2) no ledger but docs/product/session-handoff.md exists → re-read it VERBATIM with freshness stated in the directive (OQ5: freshness is stamp-first — a parseable `_Written:` ISO line beats mtime; malformed/absent stamp falls back to the mtime proxy; CURRENT only when the chosen signal is newer than the transcript — else SUSPECT, stating WHY per sub-path (stale: proven older than the transcript's last append; UNPROVABLE: transcript missing/unreadable, so no age comparison was made — F3, never a false 'older' claim), verify against git log/git status before trusting its Next); (3) neither → name git log -5, git status, .remember/now.md, tell the human the record is missing, and do NOT author a handoff now. Emits via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (jq-built so interpolated values are JSON-escaped, never executed); always exit 0 — NEVER exit 2. Body: hooks/lib/compact-resume.sh

obligations-due advisory (OQ3, SessionStart): at session start ONLY (matcher `startup|resume` — never `compact`; compact-resume owns that beat and its directive must not compete), grep-count unticked `- [ ] OB-` rows in .plans/OBLIGATIONS.md plus unticked `- [ ]` rows inside any .plans/*.state.md `## Closing` section, and inject a ≤3-line advisory naming both counts, the oldest unticked row (register first — it is append-only, so its first unticked row waited longest; bounded to 140 chars), and /agentic-workflow:settle. GREP-ONLY, NO NETWORK (L5): never runs gh, never probes a row's condition — real probes live in /settle, end.md, and check.md. Exactly four silencers (L13): (1) no register AND no `## Closing` section in any ledger → silent; (2) zero unticked rows → silent; (3) once per session ($TMPDIR marker keyed by sanitized session_id, written only when the advisory fires); (4) always exit 0 on every path (missing files, missing jq, garbage stdin) — never blocks. Emits via hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (jq-built so repo text is JSON-escaped, never executed). Body: hooks/lib/obligations-due.sh

conform-check advisory (SessionStart, matcher startup|resume — never compact): runs the plugin's tools/conform.mjs --brief against the cwd and, when the project's docs structure is behind the INSTALLED plugin (stale protocol stamp, §10 rows missing — Staging / Issue tracker —, active ledgers without Estimate:/Sessions used: or with ≠1 Next up:, no roadmap epic view, hand-written backlog, no catalog / stale catalog tooling), injects a ≤3-line advisory naming the gap count, the first gap, and /agentic-workflow:sync (which applies the SAME ladder). Silent when the cwd is not adopted (no docs/WORKFLOW.md), when conformant, when node or the script is missing; once per session ($TMPDIR marker keyed by sanitized session_id, written only when it fires); filesystem-only, no git/network; jq-built additionalContext; always exit 0. Body: hooks/lib/conform-check.sh → tools/conform.mjs

hooks.command: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '⚠️ Session ending with uncommitted tracked changes.' || true
hooks.description: Warn about uncommitted tracked work at session end
